scene1_screen1.text: The pool glistens like a postcard come to life. Palm trees sway lazily, laughter drifts over from the cabana bar, and the whole resort smells like sunscreen, rum, and expensive calm.

scene1_screen2.text: Courtney drags herself into the pool area with the grace of someone who’s just survived a hellish journey. Because she has.

scene1_screen4.text: Two buses. One missed connection. One sandwich she regrets on a spiritual level. And allnd all because some smug idiot stole her pre-paid taxi at the airport. – and she didn’t have enough cash left for another ride.

scene1_screen5.text: She tosses her bag down onto a lounger and lets out a breath, already dreaming of cold water and forgetting the last four hours of her life.

scene1_screen6.text: Then she sees him. The guy. That guy.

scene1_screen8.text: Lying poolside like a damn cologne ad — tan, relaxed, cocktail in hand, sunglasses on, shirt open just enough to annoy her.

scene1_screen9.text: Courtney decides to walk up and talk to him.

scene1_screen10.text: Hey, stranger. Missed any taxis lately?

scene1_screen11.text: Clive lowers his sunglasses, squinting at her through the sun.

scene1_screen12.text: Wait. You're—  ...Oh. You’re the woman from the airport. The very vocal one.

scene1_screen13.text: (sweetly sarcastic) You mean the one you robbed of a taxi?

scene1_screen14.text: (grinning) "Robbed" is a strong word. I prefer “opportunistic rerouting.”

scene1_screen15.text: She tilts her head, smile tight.

scene1_screen16.text: (thinking) Unbelievable. Not a single flicker of guilt. No hint of regret. Alright, buddy. Let’s see how you enjoy my special sunscreen.

scene1_screen17.text: She forces a smile, grabs the decoy bottle from her tote — the one filled with tanning accelerator instead of SPF — and walks toward him like a gift from the sun gods.

scene1_screen18.text: (brightly) Thought I’d help you out. Caribbean sun hits hard. SPF 50. You’ll thank me later.

scene1_screen19.text: She drops the bottle next to his lounger with a wink, not waiting for thanks. He blinks after her, confused but intrigued. By the time he lathers up, she’s already in the pool. Smiling. Floating. Plotting.

scene1_screen20.text: The holiday has begun, and it looks like it's going to be fun. Giving up trying to concentrate on swimming, Courtney retreats to her room while Clive stays to rest.

scene1_screen22.text: The sky is streaked with pink. The bar glows in soft lights, tropical music in the background. Courtney sips a mango margarita, her skin cool from a post-swim shower and her mood as smug as her earlier victim had been.

scene1_screen23.text: Then she hears a throat clear behind her. She turns, and nearly chokes on her drink.

scene1_screen24.text: It’s him. And he is crispy. Red shoulders. Sunglasses tan. A glowing forehead that screams bad choices were made.

scene1_screen25.text: (deadpan) Evening. Guess I misjudged the sun.

scene1_screen26.text: She takes a long, delighted sip, doing a terrible job of hiding her grin.

scene1_screen27.text: Wow. Looks like SPF 50 really let you down. Or maybe karma’s just that efficient.

scene1_screen28.text: Hmm. Funny thing, that bottle looked… familiar. Almost like someone handed it to me personally. Smiling.

scene1_screen29.text: He raises an eyebrow. She shrugs, feigning innocence.

opts.text: Flirt — lean in, spark it up

scene1_choice1_option1_screen1.text: You stole my taxi. I gave you an unforgettable souvenir. I’d say we’re even.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen2.text: Clive lets out a short laugh, wincing as it pulls on his burned shoulders.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen1.text: (mock-shocked) Me? Sabotage your delicate vacation glow? Please. I’m hurt you’d even suggest it.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen2.text: She places a hand over her chest in mock-offense, eyes wide with faux innocence.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen3.text: I gave you that bottle with all the sincerity of a weather girl warning about UV levels. You must've just... ignored the fine print.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen5.text: (smiling sweetly) I get that a lot. But let’s be honest — you did steal my cab. The universe was always going to settle the score. I’m just the charming messenger.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen6.text: She lifts her drink in a mock toast. He watches her, half-annoyed, half-amused — and possibly a little impressed.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen7.text: Next time, I’ll take the sun... and leave the sass.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen1.text: (with a smirk) Let’s just say… I like men well-done.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen2.text: Her gaze lingers a second longer than necessary, eyes flicking from his shoulders to his face with wicked delight.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (raising an eyebrow) Great. I’m flirting with the woman who slow-roasted me. This can only end well.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen4.text: (flashing a grin) Oh, I never promised an easy time. Just a memorable one.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen5.text: He chuckles, but winces mid-laugh, rubbing his neck like he’s already regretting every moment of sunshine and every second of this conversation — but not enough to walk away.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen6.text: You’re dangerous. The kind they put warning labels on.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen7.text: Lucky for you, you skipped the label. Straight to the burn.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen8.text: He stands, moving gingerly, and leans just close enough for her to catch a whisper of his cologne.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen9.text: You win the first round, Courtney. But the game’s not over.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen10.text: (tipping her glass) I was counting on that.

scene1_screen30.text: He slowly moves to the bar for a new glass. She watches him go, hiding her laugh behind another sip of margarita.

scene1_screen31.text: Just as Courtney finishes her drink, a resort host bounds up to the bar.

scene1_screen32.text: (cheery) It’s time for our nightly Blindfolded Latin Dance-Off! Grab a partner — or get paired by destiny. Winner gets extra fun - a free trip to the hot springs!! If you have paid for it in advance, we will come up with another entertainment for you!

scene1_screen33.text: Courtney rolls her eyes but follows the crowd. Curiosity — or maybe the margarita — pulls her in.

scene1_screen34.text: Before she knows it, there’s a blindfold in her hand, music in the air, and someone’s arms around her waist.

scene1_screen35.text: (smirking) If you also like stealing taxis like one guy here, I’m starting to think the universe has a sense of humor.

scene1_screen36.text: It’s not the universe. It’s skillful lurking.

scene1_screen37.text: Of course, they recognized each other, but enough time had passed from mild hostility to the relaxation of rest to enjoy the moment.

scene1_screen38.text: The music kicks up — sharp salsa rhythm, all hips and instinct. The courtyard becomes a swirl of motion, but Courtney only feels one person moving with her. They stumble, laugh, spin too fast — but the heat builds.

opts.text: Lean in — and take the lead.
Keep it cheeky — make it fun.
Keep it guarded — stay light on your feet.

scene1_choice2_option1_screen1.text: Courtney lets the rhythm take her — hips rolling, feet precise, hands confident on his shoulders. She leans in closer than necessary, close enough to feel his breath hitch.

scene1_choice2_option1_screen3.text: She turns under his arm, then pulls him back with a teasing tug. The air crackles — not just with the beat, but something sharp beneath it. Chemistry, or combustion.

scene1_choice2_option1_screen5.text: Her body speaks in pulses, her laughter low, and when his hand lingers on her waist, she doesn’t pull away. Instead, she looks up — blindfold gone now — eyes locking like she already knows how this night ends.

scene1_choice2_option2_screen1.text: Courtney goes for goofy footwork and exaggerated spins, barely holding back her giggles. She lets herself laugh when Clive missteps and mimes dramatic pain.

scene1_choice2_option2_screen2.text: You’re lucky I didn’t wear heels.

scene1_choice2_option2_screen3.text: You’re lucky I didn’t bring backup dancers.

scene1_choice2_option2_screen4.text: They whirl through the dance floor like kids at summer camp, all mischief and momentum. His hand brushes hers, hers lingers — but only just.

scene1_choice2_option3_screen1.text: Courtney follows the rhythm, keeping just enough distance to keep things safe — and a little bit sharp.

scene1_choice2_option3_screen2.text: Eyes up, hands off. You don’t get bonus points for dramatic twirls.

scene1_choice2_option3_screen4.text: But she’s smiling, even as she keeps the tension high — a dance of control. And maybe a warning not to get too close. Yet.

scene1_screen39.text: As the final notes hit, they strike a pose — a little breathless, a lot sweaty, and unmistakably in sync. Having removed the bandages, they managed to look into each other's eyes, slightly embarrassed, and then look away.

scene1_screen40.text: (amused) Well, I think the chemistry’s obvious. You two nearly set the floor on fire.

scene1_screen45.text: Courtney and Clive — perfect. You’re our winners tonight!

scene1_screen46.text: The crowd claps. Some cheer. Courtney blinks, surprised. Clive raises their joined hands like they’ve just won a championship.

scene1_screen47.text: (grinning) Your prize? Free trip to the hot springs tomorrow. Champagne included. Possibly clothing optional.

scene1_screen48.text: Courtney glances at Clive, brow raised.

scene1_screen50.text: They laugh. And for a moment, under the island lights and music still lingering, it feels like something real has started to bloom — just ridiculous enough to matter.

scene1_screen51.text: Maybe this vacation won’t be boring after all. Tomorrow brings new mischief, unexpected turns... and maybe a tan of her own.

scene2_screen1.text: Steam curls into the air as soft laughter echoes off the rocks. Guests in swimsuits sip wine in natural pools surrounded by jungle. The hot springs excursion, promised as "relaxing and restorative," is already bordering on "too good to be legal."

scene2_screen2.text: A tour guide in a linen shirt walks past with a tray of fruit skewers. Someone nearby claps. Someone else is definitely flirting.

scene2_screen3.text: Courtney, wrapped in a towel, steps cautiously into the steamy water. She’s still not entirely sure how the resort roped her into a group activity — but here she is. Floating minerals. Free sangria. Mild nudity. Fine.

scene2_screen4.text: (muttering) Relaxing, restorative, and vaguely cult-like. Fantastic.

scene2_screen5.text: She slips into the pool, shoulders sinking below the surface.

scene2_screen6.text: Clive lounges in the far pool, shirt off, hair damp, arms stretched out along the rocks like he’s posing for a magazine titled Smug Monthly.

scene2_screen7.text: They exchange a look across the rising steam. She lifts a hand in a lazy, sarcastic wave.

scene2_screen8.text: He answers with an exaggerated salute, like a smug soldier in swim trunks. She rolls her eyes, but her mouth twitches. A truce after a joint victory? Maybe, but not a fact. Hanging by a thread — and a grin.

scene2_screen9.text: Hours later, after dips, drinks, and distractions, Courtney finally decides to get out — only to discover a horrifying truth.

scene2_screen11.text: More importantly — where’s her bag? Her clothes? Her everything?

scene2_screen14.text: She spins around. He’s standing near the edge of the trail, holding her dress by two fingers like it’s a trophy.

scene2_screen16.text: Oh, I did. Revenge is a dish best served... lightly steamed.

scene2_screen17.text: She sloshes toward him through the water, not even bothering to hide the glare.

scene2_screen18.text: I gave you a sunburn, not trauma.

scene2_screen19.text: You gave me blisters shaped like regret. I think I’m being remarkably gentle.

scene2_screen20.text: She climbs out, dripping and indignant.

scene2_screen25.text: She lunges. He yelps, tosses the dress over her head, and bolts like a guilty teenager. They both dissolve into laughter.

scene2_screen26.text: At any glance it was clear that this was a couple who would have an even more fun day.

scene2_screen27.text: Evening came, bringing with it a deep violet sky and stars blinking into place, along with the news that they had to return to the hotel.

scene2_screen28.text: The final shuttle rumbles down the trail below them.

scene2_screen29.text: Neither of them is on it.

scene2_screen30.text: (wide-eyed) You’re joking. That was the last one?

scene2_screen31.text: (checking his watch) We may have gotten a little... distracted.

scene2_screen32.text: She looks around. Just steam. Jungle. One sleepy staffer in a poncho.

scene2_screen33.text: You're lucky that we always have a number for couples!

scene2_screen34.text: I suggest a room for two, it will still be more fun.

scene2_screen35.text: Well, it’s the only one left.

scene2_screen36.text: Turns out, the springs have a backup option: a tiny guest cabin with one bed, no Wi-Fi, and one bottle of emergency champagne.

scene2_screen37.text: Sighing but resigned, our couple heads to their room.

scene2_screen38.text: Inside, the space is cozy and absurd — like a honeymoon suite designed by someone who’s never seen actual romance. Dim lights, floral sheets, a fireplace with a questionable painting of dolphins above it.

scene2_screen39.text: Courtney wraps herself in a towel and flops onto the couch.

scene2_screen40.text: Well. At least it’s not a cave.

scene2_screen41.text: Clive rummages through a staff-provided box of essentials, and pauses.

scene2_screen43.text: He holds up a bundle of clothing. Only one robe and one pair of oversized men's pajamas. Courtney’s things? Gone. On the shuttle. Having a better evening than she does.

opts.text: Be a gentleman — give her the robe
Be playful — give her both and pretend it’s a fashion show

scene2_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Clive tosses her the robe without hesitation.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen2.text: Here – pretty sure it’ll look better on you.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (eyebrow raised) Trying to win me over, or just making sure you don’t get murdered in your sleep?

scene2_choice1_option1_screen5.text: She smiles and slips into the robe while he ducks into the bathroom to wrestle with the absurd pajamas.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Clive pulls off his hoodie and tosses it to her, then holds out his shorts with mock heroism.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen2.text: If I must suffer for my crimes, let it be with chivalry and legs at the mercy of mosquitoes.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen5.text: She accepts the clothes with a smirk. The hoodie swallows her, but it’s warm. And smells annoyingly good.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Clive hands her both the robe and the pajamas.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen2.text: I vote you layer these and invent a new trend. Mountain spring chic.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen4.text: Exactly. Now twirl. I demand a runway moment.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen5.text: She rolls her eyes but laughs — and twirls. Just once. Just enough to catch him smiling.

scene2_screen44.text: Later, they sit side by side on the tiny couch, sharing the champagne and avoiding eye contact. Barely.

scene2_screen45.text: The silence is soft now. Comfortable.

scene2_screen47.text: (raising his glass) For now. But I’m not saying I won’t prank you again. Just... gentler.

scene2_screen48.text: (smirking) You’re assuming I won’t strike first.

scene2_screen49.text: They clink glasses. Steam rises outside the window from the inviting jacuzzi outside...

scene3_screen1.text: The stars spill across the sky like someone knocked over a glitter jar. Steam curls gently from the edge of the private jacuzzi on the cabin deck. The jungle is quiet, except for the occasional trill of night insects.

scene3_screen2.text: Courtney sinks into the hot water with a sigh. Her borrowed robe lies draped nearby, and her skin is flushed from the heat — or maybe from something else.

scene3_screen3.text: Clive steps in beside her, careful, deliberate. His usual smirk is softer now. More curious than cocky.

scene3_screen4.text: You ever do something totally ridiculous on vacation just because it felt like a movie?

scene3_screen5.text: You mean... like swapping sunscreen with a stranger and getting stranded overnight in the jungle?

scene3_screen7.text: She laughs, and the sound slips into the night air like it belongs there.

scene3_screen8.text: They sit in silence for a moment. The kind that isn’t awkward — it’s warm. Expectant.

scene3_screen9.text: Alright. One truth for one truth?

scene3_screen11.text: I arranged this trip after a breakup. I was supposed to come here with someone. He bailed. I didn’t.

scene3_screen12.text: He nods, absorbing it. No pity. Just presence.

scene3_screen13.text: My turn: I travel alone because I used to wait for people to catch up. Now I don’t. I just go.

scene3_screen14.text: She looks at him — really looks. The water shimmers between them, and suddenly the game feels… different.

scene3_screen15.text: (softly) Not what I expected from the taxi thief.

scene3_screen16.text: Not what I expected from the sunscreen saboteur.

scene3_screen17.text: He moves closer, just a few inches, but it’s enough. The space between them hums.

scene3_screen18.text: Then it happens. A look. A lean. A kiss. Slow. Warm. The kind that says: maybe I’ve been waiting to kiss you since we first argued.

scene3_screen19.text: When they break apart, her hand stays on his chest. His forehead rests against hers.

scene3_screen20.text: (quietly) Well. That escalated in the nicest way.

opts.text: Stay in the moment — turn up the heat

scene3_choice1_option1_screen1.text: So... what happens if we don’t stop here?

scene3_choice1_option1_screen2.text: He doesn’t answer with words — just moves in, hand finding her waist under the water, gentle but sure. Their lips meet again, deeper this time, slower. Her fingers trail up to his neck, pulling him closer.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen3.text: The steam wraps around them like a secret. Laughter fades into soft breaths, warm touches, lingering kisses. The world shrinks to the space between their mouths, their hands, the quiet pulse of something real.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen4.text: When they finally pause, their noses almost touch. She laughs under her breath — low, warm, completely undone.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen5.text: (quietly) That… might be my favorite vacation detour.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen6.text: And neither of them makes a move to pull away.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen1.text: (smiling) That was... perfect. But I think I want to hold onto that and just sleep with a smile.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen2.text: He nods, no disappointment in sight.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Best idea I’ve heard all day.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen4.text: They get out together, hand in hand. As if this was always meant to happen.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen1.text: (gently) Can we stay here a little longer? Just talk?

scene3_choice1_option3_screen2.text: He grins and leans back in the water, arm brushing hers.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen3.text: If I talk too much, stop me with another kiss.

scene3_screen21.text: Later that night, the two of them lie curled on opposite ends of the same small bed.

scene3_screen22.text: Every now and then, one of them smiles in the dark.

scene3_screen23.text: Every now and then, one of them smiles in the dark.

scene3_screen24.text: Maybe it’s not just a fling. But for now, it’s enough to feel seen. To feel... chosen.

scene3_screen25.text: Think Courtney and Clive should see each other again? Hop into the chat and tell us what you’d do next...
